fields.description: The visit's name before v1.610.0 numbered it PRJ-#####-YYYY-V###: the random ID it was created with, which older review emails and links still use. Find the visit by it in a Link field's search, or with the list's Previous Number filter.
fields.label: Previous Number

fields.description: The Active contract for the Project. Empty serial_no + a Per Site Visit contract = one form covering all covered features.
fields.label: Maintenance Contract

fields.description: Set for seasonal visits (e.g. Seasonal Startup, Winterization).
fields.label: Visit Type

fields.description: Everyone booked on this visit besides the technician filling it in.
fields.label: Crew

fields.description: How long the visit takes each person. Blank: Project Planner Settings' maintenance visit hours.
fields.label: Planned hours

fields.description: The visit takes each person's whole day.
fields.label: Full day

fields.description: Pencilled in, not firm yet: the planners count it as soft hours and never as a conflict, nobody is assigned or texted it, and the customer is not told the date until it is firmed up.
fields.label: Tentative (pencil)

fields.description: Dispatch date for this visit — stamped by the scheduler from the feature's due date, shifted to a preferred visit day. Feeds the Day Board and the morning technician digest.
fields.label: Scheduled Visit Date

fields.description: The date the work was actually done. Blank means "the day it was submitted" - it is only set explicitly when a visit is logged for a past date (a backfilled form). Drives the contract cadence roll-forward, so a visit backfilled on Friday for Tuesday's work schedules the next visit from Tuesday.
fields.label: Visit Date

fields.description: Date the technician was last sent a morning dispatch digest that included this visit (each crew member's is on their crew row). Same-day re-runs skip them (at-most-once/day); if the visit is rescheduled to a later day it re-enters that day's digest.
fields.label: Dispatch Digest Sent On

fields.description: Customer date confirmation (Project Planner): the date waiting to be emailed to the customer. Written by the system.
fields.label: Customer Confirmation Due

fields.description: Customer date confirmation (Project Planner): the date the customer was last emailed. Written by the system.
fields.label: Customer Confirmed For

fields.description: General notes for the visit — the form's Dictate button writes here.
fields.label: Visit Notes

fields.description: Taken in the Visit Wizard's Wrap-up as the technician leaves: the fountain running. Printed at the end of the customer's visit report (v1.597.0).
fields.label: Fountain As We Left It

fields.description: Parts needed and work to come back for, with who on site was told. Each becomes a tracked Maintenance Follow-Up when the visit is approved.
fields.label: Follow-ups and Parts Needed

fields.description: Read-only panel — last 5 submitted visits for the Project. Rendered client-side from get_historical_visits; not a stored table.
fields.label: Historical Visits

fields.description: The technician who finished the visit signs it (the Visit Wizard's Wrap-up). Required to send the visit for review; printed on the customer's report.
fields.label: Technician Signature

fields.description: Who signed as the technician: stamped when the signature is saved.
fields.label: Technician Signed By
